title: செவ்வாய் மங்களகாரகன் - திருமண சூத்திரம் (Mars Marriage Primary Ruler)
description: In D.S.Astro System, Mars is the primary Mangalakaraka deciding marriage timing, delay, denial, love, or second marriage. Mars must be strong and free from Saturn, Ketu, Mandi afflictions.

title: திருமண தடை மற்றும் தாமத விதிகள் (Marriage Delay / Denial Rules)
description: Mars aspected by Saturn delays marriage. If Ketu/Mandi precede Mars and Saturn aspects, marriage is denied. If Saturn precedes Mars and Ketu/Mandi follow, marriage happens past age 40.

title: தசாநாதனுடன் செவ்வாய் மற்றும் 12-ம் அதிபதி தொடர்பு (Dasa Marriage Confirmation)
description: For marriage to happen in a Dasa, Dasa Lord must connect with Mars AND the 12th lord from Dasa Lord (signifying Ayana Sayana Bhoga / marital bliss), or with their dispositors/star lords.

source.section: திருமணம் எப்போது நடக்கும் என்பத பற்றிய சூத்திரம்

title: புத்தி காலங்களில் திருமணம் - திரிகோண மற்றும் இரட்டை 12-ம் அதிபதி விதி (Bhukti Timing)
description: Bhukti Lord in trine (1-5-9) to Dasa Lord precipitates marriage early. A mutual link between 12th lord from Dasa Lord and 12th lord from Bhukti Lord guarantees marriage in that Bhukti.

title: மாற்று மதத்தில் திருமணம் (Interfaith / Inter-religious Marriage)
description: 2nd or 7th lord connecting strongly with Rahu indicates alliance with Muslim / Islamic partner; with Ketu indicates alliance with Christian partner.

title: சொந்தத்திலா? அந்நியத்திலா? (Relative vs Outsider Alliance)
description: 2nd/7th lord with Mars = relative; with Sun = paternal side; with Moon = maternal side; with Mercury = maternal uncle/cousin; with Venus = spouse kin; with Saturn = outsider from workplace; with Rahu = paternal grandfather side; with Ketu = maternal grandmother side.

title: காதல் திருமணம் யோகம் (Love Marriage)
description: 2nd and 7th lords connecting with 5th or 11th lord along with Mercury (planet of romance) produces successful love marriage. If Ketu intervenes, romance is broken.

title: குடும்ப பிரிவினை / விவாகரத்து (Marital Separation / Divorce)
description: 2nd lord from natal Lagna or Dasa Lagna connecting with 6th & 8th lords along with Ketu leads to family disputes and divorce. If 2nd lord is exalted/own house, disputes exist without separation.

title: மறுமணம் / இரண்டாவது திருமணம் (Second Marriage / Remarriage)
description: Mars trapped in Papakarthari between Saturn ahead and Ketu behind, but receiving Moon's aspect (Chandra-Mangala) indicates success in a second marriage, often with a partner having prior family/child.

title: வீட்டோடு மாப்பிள்ளை யோகம் (Living with In-Laws / Matrilocal)
description: 11th lord (representing son-in-law/daughter-in-law) residing in 2nd or 4th house or connecting with 2nd/4th lord causes living permanently with in-laws.

title: துணையின் குணநலன்கள் (Spouse Characteristics)
description: 7th lord & Venus with Sun/Mars/Jupiter = upright, honorable, intellectual, fiery temperament; with Moon/Mercury/Saturn = sensual, indecisive, varied interests; with Rahu/Ketu = unconventional, intense desires.
